blocks.text: Featuring Music from All Three Seasons of the Hit Anime Series, Including an Exclusive Season 3 Encore Created for the International Tour. Performed Live to Film by the Filharmonika Orchestra Led by Music Director Emily Marshall With Vocals by Sofia Abrogar November 28–29, 2026, at Newport Performing Arts Theater The countdown to Jujutsu Kaisen in Concert has officially begun, with only weeks left before the acclaimed anime’s music takes the stage in Manila on November 28–29, 2026, at Newport Performing Arts Theater. Adding to the excitement, Film Concerts Philippines announces Sofia Abrogar, lead vocalist of Filipino alternative pop band Any Name’s […]...
